title: Moonshine

upstream_record.reported_caveat: Moonshine is worth a look if the product is English-only and the lookahead budget is tight: MIT code and MIT streaming models, low latency, C API. Confirm token/word timing before relying on it.
upstream_record.reported_precedence: add Moonshine only if the Vosk/sherpa gate is too heavy
upstream_record.reported_role: low-latency English STT content-gate candidate; very low latency, C API, streaming models
